description: California’s Largest Data Centers Are Highly Concentrated is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Mark Specht, Mark Specht. Information about the 19 largest data centers in California and their backup generating facilities. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: Excel. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0 1.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
